title: Lake Van temple basalt brought from 350 miles away
place_text: Lake Van region sites (Ayanis, Kef Kalesi, Çavuştepe), Turkey

tellings.quote: some of the balt that they used in this this construction is considered to possibly come from 350 miles away

plain: Some of the basalt used to build ancient sites around Lake Van in Turkey, such as Ayanis, Kef Kalesi and Çavuştepe, may have come from as far as 350 miles away. The researcher Matt LaCroix tells Michels this without naming a source. If so, the builders moved heavy stone over a long distance.
